name: broderick
status: SEED v0 — extrapolated from source panels 2026-06-11; refine before render
look: Hand-drawn digital yearbook-parody comic in black-and-white — scratchy caricature pen line with flat gray wash fills on the featured subject while background witnesses fade to pale ghost-gray outline. White paper grounds, no environments beyond a desk or prop. Faces are gleefully ugly: heavy brows, buck teeth, acne pustules, oversized lips. An elegant white script title on a black banner frames the series; deadpan biographies are hand-lettered in all-caps caption bands; a vertical black END bar closes.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery

ink_black.usage: subject linework, title banner, END bar, letterman sweater body

paper_white.usage: page ground; banner script and caption fields; negative space instead of sets

ghost_gray.usage: faded outline rendering of background witnesses (gawker, writing girl, smitten student)

wash_gray.usage: flat clothing fills on subjects — Doreen's skirt and top, sweater sleeves, football

shadow_gray.usage: darker accents: hair masses, skirt shadow, football panels

casting_canon.gary: Teenage boy, about 16, lean, dark mussed hair, heavy brow, lopsided smirk, t-shirt and wristband, twisted sideways at a one-piece school desk mid-performance; mugging attention-hungry class clown.
casting_canon.classmate_gawker: Scrawny teenage boy, buck teeth, bulging delighted eyes, leaning over the desk behind Gary; easily entertained audience; rendered in pale ghost-gray line.
casting_canon.classmate_girl: Teenage girl, shoulder-length hair with bangs, seated writing, eyes down; unimpressed and diligent; rendered in pale ghost-gray line.
casting_canon.doreen: Teenage girl, about 17, curvy build, dark voluminous wavy hair, heavy-lidded eyes, large glossy lips, hoop earrings and bracelets, cropped midriff-baring top, short dark skirt, arms crossed, chin raised; self-assured, soaking in attention.
casting_canon.admiring_student: Scrawny student, long straight hair, slack jaw, tongue lolling, clutching books while shuffling past; helplessly smitten.
casting_canon.flapjacks: Teenage jock, about 17, thick-necked and broad, face and neck covered in acne pustules, gap-toothed ecstatic grin, short side-parted hair, dark letterman sweater with large letter D, palming a football overhead; triumphant swagger.

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, color, saturated hues, attractive idealized faces, smooth clean vector line, detailed classroom backgrounds, full-weight background figures, screentone, soft shading

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: rough hand-drawn pen caricature, black and white comic, flat gray wash, white paper background, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.drifts_pretty: Add: ugly comic caricature, exaggerated unflattering features, heavy brow, acne, buck teeth.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add hand-lettering in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
